summary: All 4 previously-failing backend endpoints from iteration_2 are now FIXED and returning 200 with expected fields. Emerald green theme confirmed across login, admin dashboard, settings, approvals, driver dashboard. Settings page loads correctly with weekly_off_day (saturday/sunday visible) and PUT persists. Driver dashboard shows Details field + Add Remarks toggle + Submit Duty Entry. Duty Approvals page renders and reads 'Pending Approvals (0)' - cannot visually verify bulk approve/edit modal because DB has 0 pending entries (data seeding gap, not a code bug).
passed: GET /api/settings returns 200 with weekly_off_day=sunday, overtime_per_15min=25.0, all allowance fields present (FIXED from iter 2)
PUT /api/settings with weekly_off_day=saturday persists and returns updated value
GET /api/duty-entries returns 200 with all required fields (approval_status, conveyance_given, dinner_given, breakfast_given, details, remark_type, edit_count, can_edit) - FIXED from iter 2
GET /api/drivers/expiring-licenses returns 200 (FIXED from iter 2 - route ordering fixed by defining before /{driver_id})
Admin dashboard loads at /admin with emerald-themed elements

Settings page renders Weekly Off with Saturday/Sunday options, ₹ symbols on all amount fields (Overtime ₹25, Breakfast ₹100, Conveyance ₹75, Dinner ₹200), trigger times (07:30, 08:00, 11:30 PM, 11:00 PM)
Duty Approvals page renders 'Pending Approvals (0)' header (empty state working)
Driver dashboard renders 'Log Duty Time' with Date/In Time/Out Time inputs, Details textarea, Add Remarks checkbox, and emerald 'Submit Duty Entry' button
Emerald green theme confirmed: Sign In button, dashboard headings, submit buttons all use emerald color palette
